text.markup:
If Herald of Rebirth hits, put it into your hero's soul when the chain link resolves and put up to 1 card with phantasm from your graveyard on top of your deck. _(Put this card face up under your hero card.)_
**Phantasm** _(If Herald of Rebirth is defended by a non-Illusionist attack action card with 6 or more {p}, destroy Herald of Rebirth and close the combat chain.)_
